summary: The First Den is a cozy forest world centered on a live, multi-level cob house and its lakeside clearing, with authored roads leading toward Lumenvale and Hearthmere. Procedural terrain and woodland scatter sit alongside authored settlements, wildlife, small critters, and road travellers; shared managers animate these actors while the player/camera and home-interaction behaviors provide the common controls.
places: places/main - sole live place; forest-terrain height/material generator, clearing and settlement marks, woodland scatter, roads and gravity
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - spawn clearing, active cob-house, home/grounds, local wildlife, critters, road sign and traveller manager
places/main/cells/ - 56 authored cells including roads, bridges and roadside dressing, Lumenvale/Hearthmere districts, and fauna populations; objects.scene has 44 placed rows
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer world entry, default main place, player/camera, lighting, arrival behavior and UI
templates/player.js#player - player behavior stack: movement, gait, home interaction and delete mode
places/main/config.yaml - forest terrain, spawn/gravity, site/path marks and procedural decorations
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#cob-house - active procedural cob house at (0, 0.5, -26), with cellar through roof deck
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#fauna-ground + #fauna-small - single managers for the large and small local fauna families
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#road-travellers - dynamic road-actor manager; roster and appearance data in travellers.json
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#square-door - authored portal/door assembly and transition behavior
shared: scripts/forest-terrain.js - main heightAt/materialAt contract used by configured terrain and terrain-relative placements
scripts/gen/forest-plant.js + scripts/gen/valley-mesh.js - procedural vegetation builders reused across forest decoration layers
scripts/lib/road-solid.js - solid geometry helpers shared by road bridge and roadside dressing generators
scripts/lib/home-interaction.js + scripts/lib/data/home-feel.js - shared press targeting/tuning used by player home interactions
scripts/lib/data/player.yml + scripts/lib/data/camera.yml - movement/flight/rope and camera tuning consumed by their respective behaviors
scripts/lib/data/fauna-ground.json + scripts/lib/data/fauna-small.js - species/animation tuning consumed by large- and small-fauna managers
scripts/lib/data/travellers.json - road routes roster, traveller kinds, movement tuning and appearance/audio consumed by road-travellers.js
world.facts.yaml + anim/*.yml + clips/*.json - authored animation clip index and clip data for fauna and traveller animation
notableExports: scripts/forest-terrain.js - exports GROUND, SITES, LAKE, heightAt(ctx), materialAt(ctx)
scripts/gen/cob-house.js - exports HOUSE, holesFor(k), geometry(ctx), collider(ctx)
scripts/fauna-ground.js - exports scheduled update(ctx) for rows tagged fauna-ground
scripts/fauna-small.js - exports scheduled update(ctx) for small critters
scripts/road-travellers.js - exports updateSchedule and update(ctx) for dynamic road actors
scripts/gen/animal-bear.js, animal-deer.js, animal-fox.js, animal-wolf.js - species geometry/collider generators; scripts/gen/critter-*.js build small species
ownership: places/main/config.yaml + scripts/forest-terrain.js - terrain seed, material/site marks, forest scatter, and derived ground height/material
places/main/cells/*.scene - authored row IDs, placements, transforms, tags and initial state, including houses, roads, and fixed animals/critters

scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - movement intent, velocity, jump, flight and rope-climb behavior; scratch intent/timing stays in ctx.session, flying/camera mode are mirrored to player state
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - player yaw and gait channels; scripts/camera.js owns camera eye/view and local-player visibility
scripts/fauna-ground.js - movement/modes/follow, notice and pet response for tagged ground animals; species tuning lives in fauna-ground.json
scripts/fauna-small.js - small-critter animation and behavior state for fauna-small manager row; species data in fauna-small.js
scripts/road-travellers.js - dynamic traveller rows, route position, lane placement, gait/audio and session scheduling; roster/kind settings in travellers.json
scripts/delete-mode.js + scripts/ui.js - delete-mode interaction state and its HUD; UI also shows conditional dragon status
flows: places/main/config.yaml terrain.generator + seed -> scripts/forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt(ctx) -> engine terrain, river channels and forest material bands
places/main/config.yaml site/path marks + decorations -> terrain clear/grade/material features and seeded forest vegetation via scripts/gen/forest-plant.js / valley-tree.js
road marks in places/main/config.yaml -> cobbled route corridors and scatter clearings; authored cells add bridges, road dressing, signs and rest features toward Lumenvale/Hearthmere
move/look/jump/camView input -> scripts/player.js -> movement/velocity, jump, double-tap flight and camMode; place gravity applies to the character body
movement near configured rope coordinates -> scripts/player.js + lib/data/ropes.js -> climb/slide velocity and deck step-in; tuning from player.yml
move/look input -> scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js -> player yaw/gait; player body + camMode -> scripts/camera.js -> first/third-person view and local visibility
interact input -> scripts/home-player-feel.js + lib/home-interaction.js -> nearest aligned interactable press; fauna pet press writes petAt/petBy for fauna-ground manager response
scene fauna rows tagged fauna-ground + species state -> scripts/fauna-ground.js -> wander/follow/notice/pet reactions and species clips from anim/*.yml
scene critter rows + scripts/critter-press.js -> small-fauna behavior/press; scripts/fauna-small.js manager reads tagged population and plays species clips
road-travellers row + road marks + travellers.json roster -> scripts/road-travellers.js -> spawn/rebase/move dynamic walker, rider and caravan rows, animation/audio from anim/traveller.yml
square-door approach/passage triggers -> scripts/square-door.js -> portal link/door transition; authored frame and sign rows provide the assembly
dragon controls/state -> conditional scripts/player.js/camera.js/scripts/ui.js integrations; current x0z0 dragon scene row is a blueprint placeholder, not a live actor
behaviorFamilies: places/main/config.yaml decoration layers + scripts/gen/forest-plant.js / valley-mesh.js - seeded forest plants, trees, shrubs, ferns and reeds varied by layer, kind and terrain binding
scripts/gen/cob-house.js - authored procedural hexagonal multi-level house geometry/collider with cellar, spiral stair and roof deck; active at spawn
scripts/gen/road-bridge.js + scripts/lib/road-solid.js - reusable bridge geometry/collider varied by dimensions and seed
scripts/gen/road-dressing.js + scripts/lib/road-solid.js - roadside lamps, milestones, rest furnishings and sign arms varied by kind/direction/length
scripts/gen/animal-{bear,deer,fox,wolf}.js + scripts/fauna-ground.js - large animal bodies share a manager, varied by species, individual state and appearance parameters
scripts/gen/critter-{bird,duck,rabbit,squirrel}.js + scripts/fauna-small.js - small critter family uses shared management with species-specific geometry and animation
scripts/road-travellers.js + scripts/gen/traveller-{walker,rider,caravan}.js - route-driven travelers share one road manager and animation set, varied by kind, route, roster parameters and speed
templates/player.js - player behaviors compose movement, humanoid gait, home interaction and delete mode; camera is a separate custom rig
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-terrain.js - no current place config selects it; main uses scripts/forest-terrain.js
scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js - no current scene/template uses its geometry; current dragon row is a blueprint box
scripts/jade-dragon.js - no scene row attaches this actor behavior; player/camera/UI retain conditional dragon integrations
migrationNotes: forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt take a context object; main's river is at sea level y=0, ground is around y=0.5, and the spawn clearing is centered near (0,-3).
Keep places/main/config.yaml material IDs and decoration bindings coordinated; terrain marks include home/settlement clearings and cobble/gravel/yard road corridors.
The active cob-house placement (0, 0.5, -26) must stay aligned with the homeSite/homeClear terrain marks; its local levels and openings are defined by HOUSE/holesFor in cob-house.js.
Road marks and authored bridge/dressing cells are coordinated over long routes; bridge origins are at road level y=0.5 and bridge length runs along local Z.
scripts/player.js keeps high-frequency movement, flight and rope scratch in ctx.session; player.state.flying/camMode are shared toggles, while flyTapWindow is milliseconds.

Large fauna and road travelers are manager-driven rows; keep their tags, manager row, state schema, and species/roster data in sync. Small critters instead use per-row critter-press behavior plus the fauna-small manager.
